mdp.update.aria: A new version is ready — update now
mdp.update.title: Update the app
mdp.stale: No signal — showing what we last knew.
mdp.gate.title: This app needs updating
mdp.gate.lede: A newer version is required before you can carry on working.
mdp.gate.item1: Nothing on the floor is lost
mdp.logic.chargeMore: You charge {pct}% more than nearby hubs.
mdp.logic.chargeLess: You charge {pct}% less than nearby hubs.
mdp.logic.chargeSame: You charge about the same as nearby hubs.
mdp.logic.bandDetail: Your sort fee {mine} per parcel. Nearby hubs charge {median} ({min}–{max} across {count, plural, one {# hub} other {# hubs}}).
mdp.logic.sortPlace: Place parcel {id} in bag {bag}. {count} left to sort.
mdp.logic.sortEmpty: The queue is empty. Drop a bag to unload one, or scan any parcel here.
mdp.logic.sortQueuedOne: {count} parcel queued. Scan the next one.
mdp.logic.sortQueuedMany: {count} parcels queued. Scan the next one.
mdp.home.nothingToSort: Nothing to sort. Drop a bag to unload one.
mdp.home.noBagsYet: No destination bags yet. Sort parcels to start one.
mdp.home.gln: Its location number: GLN {gln}. Businesses can address goods to this hub by it.
mdp.home.feeNote: What the network pays this hub to sort one parcel. It is public — nearby hubs compete on it.
mdp.home.feeSheetBody: Senders pay this fee for every parcel your hub sorts, and you are paid it for each. A parcel already sold keeps the fee it was sold at. Nearby hubs see it and compete.
mdp.space.title: Your floor
mdp.counter.title: What your hub does
mdp.road.title: On the road
mdp.road.stop: Your hub is a stop on the road. Your floor sends towards these hubs, and to your own shops:
mdp.road.wholeVia: sealed here, passed on unopened by {hub} and the hubs after it
mdp.home.passOnFee: A whole bag passed on unopened: {fee} a bag.
mdp.home.passOnLabel: Your fee for a bag passed on unopened
mdp.home.passOnLabelIn: Your fee for a bag passed on unopened ({currency})
mdp.home.passOnHint: A whole bag for a hub further on is received on its seal here, not opened, and sent on: you are paid this for each.
mdp.home.feeWaiting: Waiting for SeeBuyGet to approve {fee} a parcel. Until then you are paid your fee as it was.
mdp.home.feeWaitingPassOn: Waiting for SeeBuyGet to approve {fee} a bag passed on. Until then you are paid your fee as it was.
mdp.home.feeRefused: SeeBuyGet did not approve the fee you asked: {reason}
mdp.home.feeCeiling: Up to {sort} a parcel and {passOn} a bag passed on is yours at once. Above that, SeeBuyGet staff approve it first.
mdp.toast.passedOnDetail: A whole bag for {final}: it stands here addressed to {next}, and is offered to drivers.
mdp.road.bins: Your hub is a stop on the road. The bins on your floor: one towards each of these hubs, and your own shops.
mdp.road.local: Your hub is local only: you sort for your own shops, and parcels passing through go by {hub} ({km}).
mdp.road.byStaff: Set by SeeBuyGet staff for your country, from the distances by road.
mdp.down.title: If the hub cannot open
mdp.down.lede: No power, a flood, nobody to work it: say so, and new bags go to other hubs until it opens again. Bags already on their way are sent on, and their drivers told.
mdp.down.untilHint: Your best guess if you are not sure: you are asked every day, and confirm on the last day before. Not confirmed, it stays closed.
mdp.down.effect: Nothing is sent to it, and bags on their way go to other hubs.
mdp.down.redirected: {n, plural, one {# bag on its way was sent to another hub.} other {# bags on their way were sent to other hubs.}}
mdp.down.ownerSays: The hub’s owner says it is down or open again in the Hub app — or ring SeeBuyGet, who can say it for them.
mdp.down.confirmed: Confirmed: it opens then, and bags are sent to it again.
mdp.down.notConfirmed: Not confirmed: the time has passed and nothing is sent to it. Say it is open when it is, or give a new time.
mdp.down.confirmNow: Confirm it opens at {until} — not confirmed, it stays closed.
mdp.down.askedDaily: You are asked every day, and to confirm on the last day before it opens.
mdp.down.collectHint: If someone can open the door, drivers may come for the bags standing here: hand each over as on any day.
mdp.down.collecting: Drivers may collect the bags standing here, since {since}.
mdp.counter.lede: Sort only, or sort and hand out: a counter at your hub where senders drop parcels off and buyers collect them, shown beside the shops while its shelf has room. It works in the Shop app, like any shop.
mdp.counter.open: Your counter is open: {fee} a parcel, {slots} places on its shelf. Parcels you sort for it go straight onto its shelf, and parcels taken in there come to your floor by hand — no bag.
mdp.counter.signIn: Open the Shop app and sign in with {email} and your hub’s password.
mdp.counter.float: Top up your counter’s float in the Shop app before it takes parcels in, as any shop does.
mdp.counter.closed: Your counter is closed: what is on its shelf is still collected there. Choose “Sort and hand out” to open it again.
mdp.counter.hoursFirst: Say your hub’s opening hours first, under “Opening hours and how to reach you”: your counter opens on them.
mdp.counter.ownerDecides: The hub’s owner decides whether it hands out.
mdp.counter.sheetLede: How many places its shelf has, and what it charges for a parcel. It is open when your hub is.
mdp.counter.feeHint: Your own fee, beside your sort fee: shown to senders and buyers as a shop’s is.
mdp.logic.sortCounter: Put parcel {id} on your counter’s shelf, slot {slot}. {count} left to sort.
mdp.zones.title: The zones you serve
mdp.zones.lede: A shop sends its parcels to the nearest hub that serves its zone and has room on its floor. Serve zones near you to sort more.
mdp.zones.standsIn: Your hub stands in {zone}: that zone is always yours.
mdp.zones.standsTaken: SeeBuyGet’s staff took {zone}, where your hub stands, away from it. Ask them if you want it back.
mdp.zones.taken: Taken away by SeeBuyGet’s staff: {zones}. Ask them to give a zone back.
mdp.zones.ownerDecides: The hub’s owner decides which zones it serves.
mdp.space.headline: {free} of {places, plural, one {# bag place} other {# bag places}} free · {perDay, plural, one {# parcel} other {# parcels}} a day
mdp.space.onFloor: On the floor: {inbound, plural, one {# bag} other {# bags}} to sort, {outbound, plural, one {# bag} other {# bags}} going out
mdp.space.coming: {count, plural, one {# bag is} other {# bags are}} on the way to you.
mdp.space.waiting: {count, plural, one {# bag waits} other {# bags wait}} elsewhere for room here: each comes by itself when you have room.
mdp.space.notSaid: Your space is not set yet
mdp.space.notSaidNote: Say how many bags can stand on your floor at once and how many parcels you sort in a day. Until you do, bags keep coming to you whatever stands on your floor.
mdp.space.over: Over full: {onFloor, plural, one {# bag} other {# bags}} on {places, plural, one {# place} other {# places}}. Every bag a driver brings is still taken. Sort and send bags on to make room — new bags go to another hub, or wait where they are, until you have.
mdp.space.full: Your floor is full. New bags for your areas go to another hub with room, or wait where they are until you have room. Bags a driver brings are still taken.
mdp.space.dayFull: Today’s sorting is full. New bags go to another hub with room today where there is one; what is not sorted today is sorted tomorrow.
mdp.space.saved: Saved. Bags waiting for room here come now if there is room.
mdp.space.sheetBody: Two numbers, so the network sends you no more than you can take. When your floor is full, new bags go to another hub for your areas, or wait where they are and come by themselves when you have room. A driver who brings bags is never turned away.
mdp.space.placesHint: How many bags can stand on your floor at once: bags waiting to be sorted, and bags being filled or waiting for a driver.
mdp.space.perDayHint: How many parcels your people sort on a normal day.
mdp.space.badPlaces: Bag places: a whole number from 1 to 10,000.
mdp.space.badPerDay: Parcels a day: a whole number from 1 to 1,000,000.
mdp.sort.title: Sort parcels
mdp.sort.lede: Scan a parcel — the screen answers which bag it goes in.
mdp.sort.queueEmpty: Queue empty — scan any parcel that is physically here.
mdp.relabel.title: Called off here: a new label
mdp.relabel.lede: Called off while it was here, it goes back to a shop as a new parcel. Print its new label, put it over the old one, then sort it.
mdp.relabel.body: {old} was called off by its store. It goes back as {new}: print its new label, put it over the old one, then scan {new}.
mdp.handover.title: Going to a door: set aside for its driver
mdp.handover.lede: It goes to a door as a load — its store’s, or the door of the person it belongs to. Keep it aside, and hand it only to the driver who took that load — scan their pass first.
mdp.handover.scanned: {parcel} goes to a door as load {code}. Set it aside, and hand it only to the driver who comes for it.
mdp.handover.waiting: No driver has taken load {code} yet.
mdp.handover.taken: A driver has taken load {code}: scan their pass to hand it over.
mdp.handover.takenBy: {name} has taken load {code}: scan their pass to hand it over.
mdp.tamper.open: Packaging cut or opened? Report it
mdp.tamper.title: Packaging cut or opened
mdp.abroad.title: Parcels abroad
mdp.abroad.toHandLede: They go abroad with this carrier, not in a bag. Check each seal is whole, then hand them over together under the carrier’s reference.
mdp.abroad.reference: The carrier’s reference: its air waybill or consignment note number
mdp.abroad.customsLede: Keep them on the customs shelf. Say what customs decided for each: released, it is sorted as any parcel; held, it stays here until what customs asks is paid.
mdp.abroad.amount: What customs asks to be paid
mdp.abroad.customsRef: Customs’ reference, as on their notice
mdp.abroad.heldLede: They stay on the customs shelf until what customs asks is paid.
mdp.abroad.lapsed: not paid in time: the sender is asked what to do
mdp.abroad.someoneElse: the sender named someone else: they pay by {date}
mdp.abroad.givenUpLede: Hand them to customs to dispose of. From then they are no longer ours.
mdp.weigh.title: Weigh a parcel
mdp.weigh.body: On a scale that counts, a parcel unlike what its sender said is kept against it, and the sender is told. The same, and nothing is kept.
mdp.weigh.same: {id}: {kg} kg — as its sender said ({said} kg)
mdp.weigh.told: Kept with the parcel, and its sender told.
mdp.tamper.body: Before it goes into a bag: photograph it as it is and report it. It is held here — sorted into no bag, loaded onto no bus — and SeeBuyGet operations is told at once.
mdp.tamper.photo: Photograph it as it is, before anything is touched
mdp.tamper.reportedDetail: SeeBuyGet operations is told. Set it apart; it is sorted once they release it.
mdp.tamper.queued: No signal — kept on this phone
mdp.tamper.queuedDetail: It goes with its photograph the moment there is a signal. Set the parcel apart meanwhile.
mdp.tamper.heldHere: Held here, not to be sorted ({count})
mdp.bag.heldDetail: SeeBuyGet operations is told. Keep it closed: it is emptied once they release it.
mdp.bag.closedSeal: Coded seal {seal}: the shop or hub it reaches reads it off the bag.
mdp.bag.closedPhoto: Photographed closed: whoever receives it compares it with your photograph.
mdp.bag.waitsTitle: It waits here for room at {hub}
mdp.bag.waitsBody: That hub has no room on its floor for another bag, and no other hub for its areas has either. Keep it on your floor: it is offered to drivers by itself when there is room, and you are told in your bell.
mdp.drop.title: Drop a bag
mdp.drop.lede: Scan the code on the bag the bus brought in.
mdp.drop.offPlanBody: {count, plural, one {# parcel in this bag was} other {# parcels in this bag were}} planned to go to {planned}, and nobody said why it came here. Nothing for you to do but sort as the screen says: {count, plural, one {it is} other {they are}} planned on from here, and operations can see it.
mdp.drop.item1: The bag is emptied and freed for reuse
mdp.drop.item2: Every parcel inside joins the sort queue
mdp.drop.item3: Sort them one scan at a time
mdp.drop.aloudReady: {count, plural, one {# parcel is} other {# parcels are}} ready to sort. Tap start sorting.
mdp.drop.aloudEmpty: Scan the bag code. The bag is emptied and its parcels join the sort queue.
mdp.load.title: Load a bag onward
mdp.load.lede: Tap the bag you are handing to the driver, then scan their badge.
mdp.load.noBags: No bags with parcels are ready to load. Sort parcels to fill one.
mdp.load.scanBadge: Scan the badge on the driver’s phone
mdp.load.oneScan: One scan moves the whole bag — every parcel inside goes on the bus.
mdp.load.aloudEmpty: No bags are ready to load. Sort parcels to fill one.
mdp.load.aloudPicked: Bag {code} is picked. Scan the driver badge, then load it.
mdp.load.aloudPick: Tap the bag you are handing over, then scan the driver badge.
mdp.newtote.title: New tote
mdp.newtote.lede: Add a fresh reusable bag to this hub's pool.
mdp.newtote.item1: The system issues a bag code
mdp.newtote.item2: Print it, laminate it, slot it into the bag pocket
mdp.newtote.item3: The bag starts free and fills as you sort
mdp.newtote.againTitle: Print the tag of a bag you have
mdp.newtote.againLede: Scan or type the bag’s code. Once SeeBuyGet has its GS1 company prefix, every tag carries the bag’s GRAI: print it again and put it in the bag’s pocket.
mdp.newtote.aloudDone: Tote registered. Print and laminate the code {code}.
mdp.newtote.aloudIdle: Tap register a tote to add a fresh bag to the pool.
mdp.rates.title: Fees near you
mdp.rates.lede: What nearby hubs charge to sort one parcel.
mdp.rates.nonePublished: No nearby hub has published a fee yet.
mdp.rates.settingBenchmark: You charge {price} — you are setting the benchmark.
mdp.rates.bandAria: Fees go from {min} to {max}. You charge {mine}.
mdp.rates.aloudNoFees: No nearby fees yet. You are setting the benchmark.
mdp.signin.spoken: Sign in with the email and password your hub uses on SeeBuyGet.
mdp.signin.title: Open the sort floor
mdp.signin.lede: Sign in with your hub's email and password.
mdp.signin.item1: The owner with the hub’s email and password; the people on the floor each as themselves, above
mdp.signin.item2: Signing out removes the key from this tablet
mdp.signin.item3: SeeBuyGet staff never ask for your password
mdp.staff.entry: I work on the floor here
mdp.staff.entrySub: Sign in as yourself, with your phone number and PIN
mdp.staff.loginLede: Your phone number and your 5-digit PIN, the same PIN you use in any SeeBuyGet app. What you do on the floor is kept under your name.
mdp.staff.pinLede: Five digits you will remember and nobody else would guess. It is yours: never tell it to the hub’s owner or anybody on the floor.
mdp.staff.placesLede: The hubs whose owner added you by your number. Say yes to one, then work its floor.
mdp.staff.noPlaces: No hub has added you yet
mdp.staff.noPlacesDetail: Ask the hub’s owner to add you under People on the floor, with your number {phone}. Then sign in again.
mdp.staff.sheetLede: You work the floor at {hub}. What you do here is kept under your name for the owner. The fee, the hub’s money and its people stay with the owner.
mdp.people.rowSub: Who works the floor, and who did what
mdp.people.title: People on the floor
mdp.people.lede: Add a person by their phone number. They say yes from their own SeeBuyGet sign-in, then sign in here with their number and PIN, and what they do on the floor is kept under their name. Take them out and they are signed out at once.
mdp.people.none: Nobody but you works the floor yet.
mdp.people.logLede: Every act on the floor, newest first, under the name of who did it. It is yours to read: it is not written on the parcel.
mdp.people.logEmpty: Nothing has been done on the floor yet.
mdp.people.state.invited: Added · has not said yes yet
mdp.papers.needTitle: Send your papers to be approved
mdp.papers.needBody: Before this hub can take bags in and sort, SeeBuyGet needs to see three things: the ID of the person who answers for the hub, its trading licence and a photo of the premises. Until then nothing is routed to it.
mdp.papers.notYetTitle: This hub is not approved yet
mdp.papers.staffBody: The owner sends its papers, signed in as the hub. Until SeeBuyGet has seen them there is no floor work here.
mdp.papers.refusedBody: SeeBuyGet wrote: “{reason}”. Put that right and send them again.
mdp.papers.sheetBody: Take each photo in good light, with every corner in the picture. Only SeeBuyGet staff see them.
mdp.papers.idPhoto: The ID of the person who answers for the hub
mdp.papers.premisesPhoto: The hub from outside, with its entrance
mdp.papers.pendingBody: They are being read. You will be told when the hub is approved, or what is still needed. Until then there is no floor work here and nothing is routed to the hub.
mdp.signin.resetDone: Your password is changed. Sign in with the new one.
mdp.signin.checkEmail: Check your email for the reset code.
mdp.toast.hubNotFoundDetail: Your sign-in works, but no hub is registered under it. Ask SeeBuyGet to check the hub record.
mdp.toast.notHubDetail: This sign-in belongs to a {role} account — open the {role} app instead.
mdp.toast.feeAskedDetail: It is above your country’s ceiling: SeeBuyGet staff approve it first. Your bell tells you when they have.
mdp.arrivals.title: Coming in
mdp.arrivals.lede: Stores bring their parcels here in bulk, on a day they booked. Count what came at the door, then scan each parcel in: from that scan it is yours to sort.
mdp.arrivals.none: Nothing booked to come yet. Stores see your days and hours when they choose where to hand their parcels in.
mdp.reach.title: Opening hours and how to reach you
mdp.reach.lede: Drivers bringing or collecting bags and stores bringing parcels see this in their apps: when you are open, who to ask for, where to come in, and a button that calls you.
mdp.reach.noHours: No opening hours yet: drivers and stores are not told when you are open.
mdp.reach.hasPhone: Drivers and stores can call you with one tap.
mdp.reach.noPhone: No number yet: nobody can call you from the app.
mdp.reach.pagePublic: On your public page: your hours, your number and where to come in.
mdp.reach.pageHoursOnly: On your public page: your hours only.
mdp.reach.saved: Saved: drivers and stores see it now
mdp.reach.sheetBody: When you are open, and how somebody at your door reaches you.
mdp.reach.keepsHours: Open on set days and hours
mdp.reach.noHoursHint: Without hours, drivers and stores are not told when you are open.
mdp.reach.phoneLabel: Number to call (your desk or your gate)
mdp.reach.phoneHint: Shown as a button that calls you, never printed. Not the number you sign in with.
mdp.reach.publish: Show my number and where to come in on my public page, for anyone
mdp.reach.publishHint: Drivers and stores working with your hub see them in their app either way. Your hours are on your public page regardless.
mdp.reach.errNoDay: Tick at least one day you are open — or untick “Open on set days and hours”.
mdp.reach.errCloses: On a day you are open, closing comes after opening.
mdp.bulk.title: Stores’ parcels in bulk
mdp.bulk.anyHour: Receives whenever the hub is working
mdp.bulk.doors: {n, plural, one {# door} other {# doors}} to unload at
mdp.bulk.pitch: Stores can bring their parcels here many at once — on pallets, in cartons — on the days you say. You count what came at the door and scan each parcel in, then sort them like any other, for your sort fee.
mdp.bulk.ownerDecides: The hub’s owner says whether it takes parcels in bulk, and when.
mdp.bulk.notTakingStaff: This hub does not take stores’ parcels in bulk. Its owner decides that.
mdp.bulk.sheetBody: Say when you receive. Stores can book only those days, on your clock.
mdp.bulk.keepsHours: Only on set days and hours
mdp.bulk.anyHourHint: Without set hours, stores may book any day: you receive whenever the hub is working.
mdp.bulk.doorsHint: How many arrivals you can unload at once.
mdp.carriers.title: Pallets, cages and crates
mdp.carriers.lede: What you move bags on to other hubs. Say each kind’s size and what it may carry: how many parcels it holds is worked out from those.
mdp.carriers.none: None said yet: bags go to other hubs as they are.
